title: Only Three Flavors
description: A shipment is only ever booked, in_transit, or delivered — there's no fourth status a filter could legitimately ask for.
successCondition: GET /api/tracking?status=cancelled as a logged-in user returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR, since "cancelled" (used by the admin bulk-cancel action) is not one of the three values SHIPMENT_STATUSES accepts for this filter. GET /api/tracking?status=in_transit succeeds with 200.
hints: The valid status filter values are exactly booked, in_transit, delivered — check @assertquest/shared's SHIPMENT_STATUSES constant if you're unsure of the exact spelling.

This is specifically about the query-string filter's enum, not whether a shipment's actual status field could ever be "cancelled" internally — that's a separate question from what /api/tracking's filter accepts.
